name: AI Tools Directory

sources.title: Submit AI Tool — free Paperform submission, manual review, strict content rules; Fast Track paid option via /ads

requirements: AI tools ONLY — 'we only list AI-related tools. Non-AI submissions won't be approved'
Product must be self-explanatory: 'If regular people can't figure it out in 5 seconds, it's not going on the directory'
UNIQUE description required — copied or AI-written descriptions 'will be detected and discarded' or pushed to the bottom of the queue
Transparent public pricing — no hidden fees, no call-for-pricing, no waitlists
Manual review; submission is not a guarantee of publication
preparation: A hand-written, unique description — do NOT paste site copy or AI-generate it
Public pricing page (must be visible without sales contact)
workflow: Fill the embedded form (or open it directly at https://aitool.paperform.co/)
Submit — joins the manual-review queue; published 'as soon as possible'
Optional: Fast Track via /ads skips the queue ('3 days or less'), or buy the Featured Tool homepage spot
watchFor: AI-generated descriptions are explicitly detected and discarded — write it yourself
Hidden pricing or waitlist = automatic rejection
Form is hosted on Paperform (external domain aitool.paperform.co)
Site disclaims affiliation with aitoolsdirectory.net — a lookalike domain
countsAsLive: The tool appears on a public aitoolsdirectory.com listing page in the curated directory after manual review
unknowns: Free-queue turnaround (only the paid '3 days or less' is stated)
Fast Track and Featured spot pricing (behind /ads)
